# Plan (muse-spark-1.3-contributor, medium)

## Goal

Ladder bots with higher target ratings get measurably stronger decks. Random bot decks bias generation toward high in-deck win-rate cards from the compiled-in `win_rates.json` table, scaled by the bot's target strength; borrowed human decklists are ranked by observed per-list performance with a sample-threshold fallback to today's random legal lists. The soft gate (`gated_sets`) and shadow-ban (`banned`) plumbing in the deck builder keeps working exactly as now.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | New `AiWinRate` struct and `AI_WIN_RATE` const (threshold, boost, floor) |
| `crates/ai/src/deck.rs` | change | New `strength` field on `AiDeckOptions`, new `win_rate_weight` helper, one multiplier in the weight closure |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/deck.rs` | change | Two tests proving strength-1 decks beat strength-0 decks and strength-0 reproduces today's decks |
| `crates/server/src/actor/engine.rs` | change | New `deal_random_deck_with_strength` and `deal_random_deck_excluding_with_strength`; old fns delegate at 0.0 |
| `crates/server/src/bots/pool.rs` | change | New `bot_target_strength` and `ranked_human_bo1_decklists`; `draw_decks`/`draw_trio` take strength |
| `crates/server/tests/bots/pool.rs` | change | Two tests: ranked-first ordering above threshold, unchanged fallback below it |

Must not touch: `crates/engine/src/`, `crates/cards/`, `spec/` and `SPEC.md`, `BUILD.md`, `crates/server/migrations/`, any `Cargo.toml` or lockfile, `crates/engine/src/wire/events.rs`, `script.rs`, `state.rs`, `effects/mod.rs`, `.github/`, `bot/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`. No new dependency. Governing spec: §9.9 (R184 deck draw, R1390 soft gate), §9.11 (R376 record, R377 in-deck breakdown, R378 sources, R1451 bot-side counting), §9.12 (R1452 strengths, R1454 bot decks, R641000 trio), §9.5 (R258 All Random deal). No new ruling: this is data-driven deck tuning, following the precedent of `DEALT_Q`/`lean_boost`, which landed as constants plus tests; reuse R377's in-deck figures and the `CARD_STATS_MIN_SAMPLE` (20) precedent, so no undecided rules question arises.

## Steps

1. `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: add `pub struct AiWinRate { pub min_games: i32, pub max_boost: f64, pub floor: f64 }` and `pub const AI_WIN_RATE: AiWinRate = AiWinRate { min_games: 20, max_boost: 3.0, floor: 0.25 }`. Copy the doc-comment style of `AI_DECK`'s `lean_boost` paragraph. Rationale for values: 20 matches `CN_TECH_MIN_GAMES` and `CARD_STATS_MIN_SAMPLE`; 3.0 sits beside `theme_boost` 4.0 so win-rate never outranks theme/curve shaping.
2. `crates/ai/src/deck.rs`: add to `AiDeckOptions` a field `pub strength: Option<f64>` with `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]` and doc comment (0.0 = today's deal, 1.0 = full bias; values clamp to 0..1). Add `use crate::config::AI_WIN_RATE;` beside the existing `AI_DECK_GATED_SETS` import.
3. `crates/ai/src/deck.rs`: add `fn win_rate_weight(id: &str, strength: f64) -> f64` before `build_ai_deck_traced`. It reads `jackioh_engine::registered_win_rates()`, finds the row for `id`, returns 1.0 when `strength <= 0.0`, when no row exists, or when `row.games < AI_WIN_RATE.min_games`; else `rate = wins as f64 / games as f64`, `1.0 + strength * AI_WIN_RATE.max_boost * (rate - 0.5) * 2.0`, clamped to `[AI_WIN_RATE.floor, 1.0 + AI_WIN_RATE.max_boost]`. No id or set literal appears; skip nothing by name (ban/gate filtering already happened in the pool). Import `registered_win_rates` through the existing `jackioh_engine::{...}` use.
4. `crates/ai/src/deck.rs`: in `build_ai_deck_traced`, compute `let strength: f64 = options.strength.unwrap_or(0.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0);` next to the `boost_by` line, and multiply `weight *= win_rate_weight(&def.id, strength);` in the weights closure after the `boost` block. Strength 0.0 multiplies by exactly 1.0, so every existing seed deals today's deck.
5. `crates/server/src/actor/engine.rs`: add `pub fn deal_random_deck_with_strength(seed: &str, lean: Option<SetName>, strength: f64) -> Vec<String>` holding the current `deal_random_deck` body plus `strength: Some(strength)` in the `AiDeckOptions`; make `deal_random_deck` delegate with `0.0`. Add `deal_random_deck_excluding_with_strength(seed, excluded, strength)` the same way over the current excluding body; old fn delegates at `0.0`. Player paths (queue, rematch, All Random) keep calling the old fns, so human decks stay unbiased.
6. `crates/server/src/bots/pool.rs`: add `pub fn bot_target_strength(strength: usize) -> f64` mapping `BOT_STRENGTHS[strength].seed_rating` onto 0..1 using the runtime min/max over `BOT_STRENGTHS` (no hardcoded ratings), clamped, `0.0` for an out-of-range index.
7. `crates/server/src/bots/pool.rs`: replace `human_bo1_decklists` with `ranked_human_bo1_decklists` returning `(ranked: Vec<Vec<String>>, unranked: Vec<Vec<String>>)`. Group live human Bo1 seats by sorted-ids key, counting wins (seat == winner; a draw is a game not won, mirroring `card_stats`'s `outcome_for`) and games per distinct list. Lists with `games >= CARD_STATS_MIN_SAMPLE` (as `usize`) go to `ranked`, sorted by exact win-rate compare (`a.wins * b.games` vs `b.wins * a.games` as `i64`, the `win_rate_leader` precedent), ties by more games then by joined-ids ascending; the rest go to `unranked` in record order. `CARD_STATS_MIN_SAMPLE` is `i64`; cast for compare.
8. `crates/server/src/bots/pool.rs`: change `draw_decks(seed, records, catalog)` to `draw_decks(seed, records, catalog, strength: f64)`. Build `candidates` as `ranked` (in performance order, unshuffled) followed by `rng.shuffle(unranked)`, truncate to `BOT_DECK_DRAW_ATTEMPTS`, then the existing legality loop; pass `strength` into the `deal_random_deck_with_strength` fallback calls. Change `draw_trio(seed, own, catalog)` to take `strength: f64` and pass it to `deal_random_deck_excluding_with_strength`. Update `refresh_pool` to pass `bot_target_strength(bot.strength)` at both call sites.
9. Update the two existing `draw_decks` unit-test call sites in `crates/server/tests/bots/pool.rs` (they pass `&seed, &records, &app.catalog`) to add `0.0`; with threshold-20 ranking their 1-game records all land unranked, so their assertions hold unchanged.

## Tests

- `crates/ai/tests/ai/deck.rs`, `win_rate_strength_deals_higher_mean_win_rate`: register a synthetic table via `jackioh_engine::testkit::register_win_rates` (10 Core/Classic ids at 80/80 wins/games, 10 at 20/80, rest absent), deal 200 seeds at size 20 with `strength: Some(1.0)` vs `strength: None`, assert the strength-1 mean in-deck win rate (from the same table) exceeds the unbiased mean by at least 5 points; call `clear_overrides()` at the end. - `crates/server/tests/bots/pool.rs`, `r1454_below_threshold_lists_fall_back_to_shuffle`: 1-game records for two lists, assert over 10 seeds both lists appear first at least once (today's shuffle behavior preserved).

## Done when

- [ ] Biased random bot decks: strength-1 mean in-deck win rate beats strength-0 by 5+ points
